title: Join us for the July 9th, 2026 PanKbase Office Hours
bodyHtml:
Join us for the next PanKbase Office Hours:
? Identifying disease-associated cellular states in the pancreas
? Thursday, July 9th, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET
?️ Featured speaker: Kyle Gaulton, PhD, UCSD

What topics will we cover in this forum:

  • Definition of cellular states/gene programs in a cell type by combining manual curation with computational inference of single cell data, and how input from experts can help improve these programs
  • Approaches for determining which states/gene programs are involved in disease by combining genetic risk enrichment and genomic changes in disease
  • Tools for interactive visualization of states/programs in each cell type including important genes and disease risk/association


? Register for the event: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN__dgDoIUZSVyPwKvZ3Xx7mQ
